Executive Summary & Website Structure

1. Executive Summary & Project Objectives

This document presents the strategic website architecture and content distribution proposed for GREEN ALEX. The primary objective is to build an authoritative, modern corporate digital presence tailored for international food buyers, supermarket procurement teams, and commercial importers.

Company Identity & Corporate Background

Company Name: GREEN ALEX (شركة جرين أليكس للحاصلات الزراعية)
Specialization: IQF fruits, IQF vegetables, and processed ready-to-cook items.
Established: 1999 (Over 27 years in Food Processing).
Founder / Owner: Dr. Mohamed Gabr.
Commercial Registration: Rashid, Beheira Governorate, Egypt.
Administration Office: 10 Ibn Shogaa Street, Al-Azareeta, Alexandria, Egypt.
Website Languages: Bilingual parity (English & Arabic).

Website Purpose & Boundary Constraints

The agreed project scope is strictly a Corporate Portfolio Website. It is designed to establish international B2B credibility, showcase product capabilities, demonstrate adherence to strict food safety standards, and facilitate direct export inquiries.

Strict Scope Boundaries:
• NOT an e-commerce or cart-checkout platform.
• NOT an online transactional consumer shop.
• NOT an operational internal ERP or export freight portal.

PAGE 02 — ABOUT US (نبذة عن الشركة)
Architecture Spec

Primary Purpose: Present the company’s history, executive leadership, operational approach, and tailoring capabilities to build solid B2B trust without unsupported claims.

English Corporate Profile

"GREEN ALEX is an Egyptian food-processing company established in 1999 and founded by Dr. Mohamed Gabr. The company focuses on the processing and supply of individually quick frozen (IQF) fruits and vegetables, alongside selected processed and ready-to-cook products.

With a seasonal raw-material approach, GREEN ALEX plans production around optimum crop availability and customer specifications. Product styles, grading, cutting sizes, blends and packing formats can be tailored subject to raw-material availability, approved specifications and production capability."

نبذة عن الشركة باللغة العربية

"شركة GREEN ALEX هي شركة مصرية تأسست عام 1999 على يد الدكتور/ محمد جبر، وتعمل في مجال تجهيز وتصنيع وتوريد منتجات الفواكه والخضروات المجمدة بالتجميد الفردي السريع (IQF)، إلى جانب بعض المنتجات المصنعة والجاهزة للطهي.

تعتمد الشركة على التخطيط الموسمي لتوافر المحاصيل الزراعية، مع إمكانية تقديم أشكال تصنيع ومقاسات تقطيع ودرجات فرز وخلطات وتعبئة مختلفة وفقاً لمتطلبات العملاء، وبما يتوافق مع توافر الخامات والمواصفات المعتمدة والطاقة الإنتاجية."

B. International References (المراجع والمواصفات الدولية)

Reference Code Title Scope & Technical Relevance
Codex CXS 320-2015 Standard for Quick-Frozen Vegetables Product definition, quality factors, defects, contaminants, labelling.
Codex CXC 8-1976 Code of Practice for Quick-Frozen Foods Good handling practices, freezing, storage, and distribution.
Codex CXS 1-1985 General Standard for Labelling Prepackaged Foods Food-label information and mandatory declarations.
Codex CXS 193-1995 General Standard for Contaminants in Food Permitted contaminant threshold limits.
Codex Pesticide MRLs Maximum Residue Limits for Pesticides Check commodity/pesticide combinations and market limits.
ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management Systems FSMS framework; certification by accredited body.
HACCP / CXC 1-1969 General Principles of Food Hygiene HACCP hazard analysis and critical preventive controls.
BRCGS / IFS Food GFSI-Recognized Schemes Customer / retailer-driven certification schemes where required.

C. Core IQF Quality Control Points (نقاط الفحص الأساسية)

1. Raw Material: Approved source, maturity, freshness, incoming inspection.
2. Preparation: Washing, sorting, trimming, peeling, cutting to spec.
3. Blanching: Enzyme inactivation applied where validated.
4. Freezing: Target -18°C or colder at thermal center.

5. Finished Product: Colour, flavour, texture, defects, pack integrity.
6. Food Safety: Micro/chemical/physical hazard controls; MRL testing.
7. Cold Chain: Continuous -18°C through storage and export distribution.
8. Traceability: Batch coding, production records, temperature logging.

Mandatory Legal Compliance Disclaimer (Preserved Exactly)
"Listing a standard on this website does not mean that GREEN ALEX is certified to that standard, nor does it mean that every listed standard applies to every product. The current official text, status and scope must be verified with EOS and the competent authority. Destination markets and individual customers may impose additional requirements."
